\begin{example} \end{example}[Differentiated expansion remainder] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0254 1. ch23:23.18\group Asymptotics

For $w_N$ the remainder above, \[ |\partial _t^\ell \nabla _x^kw_N|=O(t^{N+1-n/2-k-2\ell }) \] uniformly as $t\to 0$. \end{example}
Proof

\sketch Differentiate the convolution representation of $w_N$ and use the derivative estimates for the parametrix error; the same time integral gains one power of $t$.
